heading: The `ambient` modifier
text:
### The `ambient` modifier [LSCP.2.5]

`ambient` is a read-only permissions modifier over a base lifecycle,
written `scope <base> ambient` ([LSCP.1.5]). The base — `logical` or
`ttl` — supplies the fact's lifecycle and identity; `ambient` adds only
the read-only boundary. v1 admits `scope logical ambient` only
([LSCP.2.5.9]).
